Name: arr
Description: Certified Finance ARR: sum of annual_value of contracts in force on the measurement date. Slice by ARR_MONTH, REGION, SEGMENT, CONTRACT_TYPE or PRODUCT_FAMILY; filter one ARR_MONTH (2026-10-01 for current).

Name: active_contracts
Description: Number of recurring contracts in force on the measurement date.

Name: finance_arr
Description: Finance ARR as reported alongside the Sales Ops figure; identical definition to arr.

Name: salesops_arr
Description: Sales Ops ARR: Finance ARR plus lapsed contracts whose renewal opportunity is still open in Salesforce. Not the certified figure.

Name: lapsed_open_arr
Description: ARR of lapsed contracts still counted by Sales Ops because the renewal opportunity is open; the difference between the two ARR figures.

Name: arr_gap_pct
Description: Sales Ops ARR minus Finance ARR as a share of Finance ARR.

Name: arr_due
Description: ARR of contracts that reached their end date in the period.

Name: arr_renewed
Description: ARR renewed: a successor contract was signed.

Name: arr_churned
Description: ARR closed lost after the contract lapsed.

Name: arr_pending_renewal
Description: ARR of lapsed contracts whose renewal is still open.

Name: renewal_rate
Description: Certified renewal rate: ARR renewed divided by ARR due. Slice by FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_QUARTER, REGION, SEGMENT, CONTRACT_TYPE or PRODUCT_FAMILY.

Name: churn_rate
Description: ARR churned divided by ARR due.

Name: contracts_due
Description: Number of contracts that reached their end date in the period.

Name: arr_renewing_90d
Description: ARR of active contracts ending in the next 90 days (2026-10-13 to 2027-01-10).

Name: arr_at_risk_90d
Description: ARR renewing in the next 90 days that the renewals team flagged AT_RISK.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_RENEWALS_AT_RISK_90D.RISK_FLAG = 'AT_RISK' THEN V_RENEWALS_AT_RISK_90D.ANNUAL_VALUE ELSE 0 END)

Name: contracts_renewing_90d
Description: Count of active contracts ending in the next 90 days.

Name: contracts_at_risk_90d
Description: Count of contracts renewing in the next 90 days flagged AT_RISK.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_RENEWALS_AT_RISK_90D.RISK_FLAG = 'AT_RISK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: arr_renewing_90d_end_of_support
Description: ARR renewing in the next 90 days on products reaching end of support within 12 months.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_RENEWALS_AT_RISK_90D.IS_END_OF_SUPPORT_WITHIN_12M = 1 THEN V_RENEWALS_AT_RISK_90D.ANNUAL_VALUE ELSE 0 END)

Name: active_systems
Description: Number of active installed arrays.

Name: systems_end_of_support_12m
Description: Active arrays whose product reaches end of support within 12 months of 2026-10-12.

Name: systems_with_active_support
Description: Active arrays covered by a support contract today.

Name: support_coverage_rate
Description: Share of active arrays covered by a support contract today.

Name: avg_health_score
Description: Average AutoPulse health score for September 2026 across active arrays (below 70 is poor).

Name: installed_capacity_tb
Description: Raw capacity of active arrays in terabytes.

Name: support_attach_rate
Description: Systems with a support contract starting within 60 days of install divided by systems installed. Slice by PARTNER_NAME and FISCAL_YEAR.

Name: systems_installed
Description: Systems installed in the period (since 2024-05-01).

Name: cloud_commit_amount
Description: Committed cloud spend for the fiscal year to date.

Name: cloud_consumed_amount
Description: Metered cloud consumption for the fiscal year to date.

Name: cloud_commit_utilization
Description: Consumed divided by committed cloud spend; under 0.60 is under-utilised.

Name: under_utilized_cloud_accounts
Description: Customers consuming less than 60 percent of their cloud commit in the fiscal year.

Name: cloud_overage_amount
Description: Consumption billed above the monthly commit.

Name: monthly_cloud_consumption
Description: Metered cloud consumption in USD by USAGE_MONTH; compare the same months year over year for growth.

Name: support_cases
Description: Number of support cases opened. Slice by OPENED_MONTH, REGION, PRODUCT_FAMILY, PRIORITY, CATEGORY or FIRMWARE_VERSION.

Name: p1_cases
Description: Number of P1 (production down) cases opened.

Name: open_cases
Description: Cases still open as of 2026-10-12.

Name: avg_csat
Description: Average customer satisfaction score (1-5) on closed cases.

Name: bookings
Description: Booked amount after discount from SAP orders (total contract value; not ARR).
